description: Goes past 'top-10 = X%' to classify the holder base: how much the creator & owner still hold, which top holders are infrastructure (LP/CEX/bridge — benign) vs unlabelled wallets (the concentration that can actually dump the price), and the largest non-infra wallet. Separating benign from dangerous concentration is the analysis others skip.
